columns.I_A: arc current on [t, t+dt) (A); 0 during cooldown
columns.P_abs_logged_W: AdditiveFOAM domain-integrated source averaged over (t-0.1 s, t] (W)
columns.T_top_roi_mean_K: area-weighted mean top temperature in a 10 mm x 10 mm square centred on the torch (K)
columns.T_min_3d_K: minimum over cells and boundary faces (K); must not fall below T_inf
columns.top_area_above_3000K_mm2: top-surface area above 3000 K (mm^2); superheat the heat-only model cannot limit (steel boils near 3100 K)
columns.top_area_liq_mm2: top-surface area with T > liquidus, bilinear on 0.05 mm (mm^2)
columns.top_length_liq_mm: x extent of the top-surface liquidus region (mm)
columns.top_width_liq_mm: y extent of the top-surface liquidus region (mm)
columns.top_centroid_x_liq_mm: centroid x of the top-surface liquidus region (mm)
columns.top_centroid_y_liq_mm: centroid y of the top-surface liquidus region (mm)
columns.depth_liq_mm: maximum depth below the top of T >= liquidus, linear in z per column (mm)
columns.vol_above_liq_mm3: volume of cells with T > liquidus (mm^3)
columns.vol_above_sol_mm3: volume of cells with T > solidus (mm^3)
columns.Tbar_max_K: maximum of the thickness-averaged temperature (comparable to 2D peak_T)
columns.Tbar_area_Tm_mm2: area where the thickness-averaged T > (solidus+liquidus)/2 (2D pool_area definition)
columns.Tbar_area_liq_mm2: area where the thickness-averaged T > liquidus (mm^2)
columns.H_J: enthalpy rise of the plate rel. solid at T_inf, sensible + latent (J)
columns.delta_H_K: H / (rho cp_ref V_plate), cp_ref = model cp at T_inf (K)
columns.dHK_ring_5_15mm_K: enthalpy rise per rho cp_ref V in the full-thickness ring 5-15 mm from the torch axis (K)
columns.dHK_lower_half_K: enthalpy rise per rho cp_ref V of the lower half of the plate, z < -H/2 (K)
columns.E_src_J: cumulative absorbed energy from the solver log (J)
columns.Q_loss_W: convective + radiative loss rate over all patches (W)
columns.residual_rel: residual_J / total absorbed energy of the run
columns.window_clipped_liq: 1 if the liquidus region touched the pool-metric window edge
columns.window_clipped_sol: 1 if the solidus region touched the pool-metric window edge
